Reverse a linked list in place

Company: Acme Corp · Role: SDE 1 · Round: Tech · Year: 2024 · Published: 2026-08-01

Topics: arrays, linked lists

Difficulty: 3.4 (out of 5, 12 votes)

Prompt

Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list in place and return the new head. Do not allocate extra memory. Handle the empty list and single node cases.

Answer guidance

Walk through pointer manipulation step by step. Mention the time and space complexity. A common follow up asks for reversing a sublist between two indices.
